Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.1.1.101)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin27.0.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin
result.method: Whole processes, one warmup and rotating NIL/C++/Python order. Compilation and output verification excluded. Cached files, no fsync or CPU isolation. Append loops in all languages; report uses incremental NIL/C++ and idiomatic Python join. Newline count uses a NIL/C++ scan and Python bytes.count; reduce uses a native i64 buffer/vector and Python list/sum. These are semantic equivalents, not identical runtime algorithms. Byte-sum is the branchless scan control; newlines_call preserves identity helpers in lazy arms; leaf uses a scalar comparison helper; seq_leaf passes the sequence into a checked-reading helper. noinline and recursive use a benchmark-only IR hook on helper nil_fn2, with noinline and disable-tail-calls attributes, to preserve actual calls. Nested scans use 256-byte inner loops; seq_return carries a sequence through an identity-returning helper, outside the scalar proof. C++/Python use the same direct count reference for every scan shape, not matched function shapes. No LLM/token efficiency inference.
